reviews.x: I am not sure what is in this but I had a huge allergic reaction to the point of anaphylaxis! I will only order from the actual Ordinary company moving forward. It happened twice and when I stopped using it I never had another episode.

I only use it at night as it is a little sticky and doesn't sit well under my makeup, but I am definitely impressed with the way my skin looks after a week of use.  I have dark bags under my eyes and I haven't found anything at all to help with them.  I started using this every night and then every other night I use my derma roller with it.  The bags are diminishing and I am really happy with this product. Will definitely be buying this again.  I also use the ordinary lactic serum.  Love it too!
Excellent product for the price and I have used expensive high end products from my plastic surgeon's and dermatologist office .

There is no way this is the same product. The product I received from Amazon is the light blue and is sticky and thick. The dark blue is the product I got in the past from the ordinary and is thin and runs fast.

I like it so far, first copper topical agent I’ve tried since learning about the benefits of copper for your skin.  So far I think it’s doing what it’s supposed to be doing!  Over half done with the first bottle.  Not moisturizing as far as I can notice anyway, thick and kindof sticky.  I follow it up with other stuff like peptides and another aureuvedic oil blend so it all absorbs.  I don’t use it at the same time as vitamin C products, copper and vitamin C sortof cancel each other out I guess.
Great product, but didn't notice much of a difference between this particular product and The Ordinary Buffet w/out copper peptides.  I'm switching back to The Ordinary Buffet.

reviews.t: Yes, it is THE REAL DEAL!
reviews.x: I was so worried after noticing the reviews that I high tailed it to Ulta to compare. I don’t want questionable stuff in my mug! So after purchasing and comparing. It is exactly the same stuff. Actually packaged better than when you get it at the store. No scent. I’ve only used it once. I will post photos etc later and revisit after a month. With all you get in this little bottle, it is worth it! Sooo many peptides! I was so paranoid about this being fake I even sent photos to the manufacturer!

I don't understand the negative reviews. I have been using this product for a little over three months now and I use it every night. I incorporate it into my nightly skincare routine. It is a bit sticky, but it is not that sticky that it doesn't eventually dry. Maybe those people are using too much? My skin looks so much better since I started using it. I will continue to buy it.

reviews.t: Love It! Should Be a 5-Star Product!
reviews.x: I was shocked to see this product showing only 3 stars! Pricing here is way too high but not double. Let’s ignore the price for a minute. I’m on my 3rd bottle. I’m 67 years old and a former esthetician. At this point, about 4 months in, I don’t think I need to keep searching for a perfect serum at a reasonable price. My nighttime routine is a little varied  from my morning routine but The Ordinary, Buffet with Copper Peptides is in both.
Way over priced. Buy it direct from the website to save a lot of money.
This product is a total knock off from the real ordinary buffet + copper peptides!!! This is way too watery!!! The real one is thick!! I was warned but didn’t listen!

I have bought this product multiple times from other stores and every time it has been a very noticeable blue color. But the product I received after ordering on amazing was completely clear with absolutely no blue color. This product is a scam it has to be blue in color to know it contains the copper peptides. Do not buy from Amazon
This product is fraudulent. This is not the ordinary serum. This was reported to Amazon and they did not remove the product.

I had gotten this because of a youtube influencer…. and I was HIGHLY skeptical, but decided to do it anyway. So glad I did. This IS the real thing, even though I see some people said it’s fake. This is the actual product and it works marvelously. (Yes it’s supposed to be blue) My skin looks so much more plump and healthy. I’m in love! Please note, this does take about a month or so to see results so don’t be discouraged. Wonderful product that I came across and so glad I looked into it.  If you’

reviews.t: Not the actual ordinary copper peptides
reviews.x: What in the world. I’ve been buying this serum for a few years now and first time ordering it off of Amazon and it’s NOT the same product?? What?! Much much lighter in color, it’s clear there is no copper in this serum hence the blue color.  I swear this happened to another product I ordered on Amazon that was a completely different formula more so watered down. What’s going on here Amazon?

reviews.t: This product sells on website for less than half the price seller charges
reviews.x: Stars are deducted for price only. This is literally about 10 dollars on the Deciem website. The product is amazing though. Has a slick texture and a glue? kinda smell, but it works beautifully. I have yet to meet a Deciem product I don't love.

reviews.t: Is it supposed to stain skin blue???
reviews.x: I’ll change my rating if I see improvement in my skin, but it stains my skin a dark blue that doesn’t wash off…. I know coper is blue, but this seems odd…
The serum I received is NOT the Buffet with Copper Peptides. This is a clear serum.  Buyer beware.  Now I have to go out of my way to return this garbage
The first time I ordered this from here the serum was blue as it should be. Just received my 2nd bottle and it’s clear. I’m going to try and return as it should be blue serum. I’m pissed

Havent had it that long to see any results but ingredients are pretty good for the price. Serum is thick but certainly easy enough to apply. Everything takes some time!skin changeover is gradual no matter what at least for me
Used for about 6 months now. Smooth and absorbs well. Use every night. Helps with redness and texture.

reviews.t: Great product at an amazing price.
reviews.x: Amazing.  I use it every morning.  It makes a visible difference.
Have used product in past, always pleased with quality and results.
If - IF - the is the real product the regular price for this is $29.00.  This product is very popular since so affordable and great quality.  Do you research before buying from random sellers online.
PRICE IS NUTS. I bought this several times & love it. But it was under $15-- or even less.  Check the direct Canadian  DECIEM website for fair pricing. THIS PRICE IS AWFULLY HIGH.

claims.text: Several reviewers believe the product is fake or not the genuine The Ordinary serum, citing differences in color and consistency.
Some reviewers report the product is authentic and works well, contradicting claims that it is fake.
Multiple reviewers describe the product as sticky or thick in texture.
Some reviewers feel the product is overpriced, especially compared to buying direct.
Reviewers report positive results on their skin after consistent use.
